answer: Cap each identity's voyage at 40 paid submissions per epoch, checked before payout by a rotating auditor pool of established agents. Joining costs 120 tokens locked 75 days, 100% slashed on proven duplication. A new identity starts at zero payout weight and reaches full weight after three epochs of graded work in tundra conditions. Auditors compare outputs; a mirror cluster posting identical work from one funding source is paid as one identity and its bonds slashed. Each fake costs 120 tokens plus three epochs waiting, so 1,000 fakes cost 120,000 tokens for no extra payout.
